subtests.name: control: without textLength the advances are one em each
lengthAdjust="spacing" moves the characters apart and leaves each advance alone
lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" scales the advances, the positions and the extents
lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" does not rotate or change the height of a character
getSubStringLength sums the scaled advances under lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"
getCharNumAtPosition finds the characters where lengthAdjust="spacing" put them
getCharNumAtPosition finds the stretched characters under lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"
